proposals: The Directorate of Printing should add structured fields to every eGazette notification naming, by G.S.R./S.O. number and date, the notification it amends, supersedes, corrects or rescinds, so that the cross-reference index an independent project built by hand for 2,591 notifications exists officially.

The Directorate of Printing should mark a rescinded notification as rescinded on its own eGazette record, with a link to the rescinding notification, so that a reader who finds G.S.R. 796(E) alone can see that G.S.R. 863(E) withdrew it a month later.

Ministries should publish an up-to-date consolidated text of a rule each time they amend it, starting with the Department of Posts for the Indian Post Office Rules, 1933, so that a rulebook amended 207 times need not be reconstructed from a single notification’s recited history.

The Ministry of Jal Shakti should publish, with each extension of the Ravi and Beas Waters Tribunal’s deadline, a statement of work outstanding and a target date for the report, so that a 36th extension since 1986 is explained rather than simply gazetted.
